caption: Desert at sunset: long warm shadows over rippled sand, saturated orange-to-purple sky gradient, one lone landmark as the focal point

camera.notes: wide and low; horizon on the lower third, sky dominates

lighting.environment: sunset preset, sun close to the horizon at 20-30 degrees off the camera axis
lighting.key: the sun, strongly warm, intensity 4-5 for long hard shadows
lighting.fill: purple-tinted sky fill at one quarter of key intensity
lighting.rim: none; the sun's grazing angle already edges every dune

notes: sand texture tiled so texels stay square across the large ground; keep prop count low, emptiness is the composition
